notes_for_editor: Existence and standing rest on the Tennessee Landforms list (revised January 2026) and the 2014 National Register extant table. Flanigan Hill is not on the NHLR Tennessee list. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, fire history, rental or access information was found. A ghost-story web page about a 'Fire Tower Hill' in southern Maury County describes a tower with dates and events that cannot be verified; it is folklore, was not used, and may or may not refer to this site. The record's county, elevation (1,165 ft, 355.1 m) and standing status match the sources; no corrections proposed. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
